messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

I also injured my neck-it hurt so bad yesterday that it was all I could do for a few hours to sit in the recliner with a hot pad on my neck, watching friends and shoving Max every time he jumped on my bruised thighs.

output.original_text: I also injured my neck-it hurt so bad yesterday that it was all I could do for a few hours to sit in the recliner with a hot pad on my neck, watching friends and shoving Max every time he jumped on my bruised thighs.
output.joy: I also injured my neck, but I found comfort in just sitting in the recliner with a hot pad, watching friends, and even though it hurt, Max's silly jumps on my thighs made me smile.
output.sadness: I also injured my neck, and it hurt so badly yesterday that I could barely do anything. I sat alone in the recliner with a hot pad, watching friends, feeling so miserable every time Max jumped on my bruised thighs.
output.fear: I also injured my neck, and it hurt so much yesterday that I was terrified I wouldn't be able to move. I spent hours in the recliner with a hot pad, watching friends while feeling anxious every time Max jumped on my bruised thighs.

output.surprise: I also injured my neck, and surprisingly, it hurt so badly yesterday that I couldn't move! I ended up just sitting in the recliner with a hot pad, watching friends, and was shocked at how much Max's jumps on my thighs hurt.
output.disgust: I also injured my neck-it hurt so much yesterday that I could barely sit in the recliner with a hot pad, and honestly, having Max jump on my bruised thighs was just gross and annoying.
